proposal.summary: MXsecurity versions prior to 1.0.1 contain an authentication bypass when the web service authenticator uses insufficiently random values, allowing a remote attacker to access the system.
proposal.cwe_quote: if the web service authenticator has insufficient random values

AV.quote: A remote attacker might access the system

PR.quote: A remote attacker might access the system

C.quote: A remote attacker might access the system

I.quote: A remote attacker might access the system

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request a detailed technical report from the reporter with reproduction steps, exact authentication mechanism affected, and example of insufficient randomness; ask vendor for confirmation of affected components and mitigation or patch availability for MXsecurity 1.0.1.

evidence_quotes.quote: There is a vulnerability in MXsecurity versions prior to 1.0.1
can be exploited to bypass authentication. A remote attacker might access the system
if the web service authenticator has insufficient random values
